query: I’m assessing an 86-year-old man: among male ICU patients aged 81–91, what percentile is a per-stay average systolic BP of 150 mmHg over the first 48 hours?
final_sql: SELECT percentile_cont(0.9) within GROUP (ORDER BY AVG(labevents.value)) AS percentile FROM labevents JOIN icustays ON labevents.subject_id = icustays.subject_id WHERE labevents.itemid = 84807002 AND icustays.patient_gender = 'M' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM icustays.intime) BETWEEN 2018 AND 2019 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM age(CURRENT_DATE, icustays.patient_dob)) BETWEEN 81 AND 91 AND labevents.charttime BETWEEN icustays.intime AND (icustays.intime + interval '48 hours');
